recipe: void __fastcall w30c_untab(unsigned char **dst, unsigned char **src) — EXACT with no maps/patches/aliases; fastcall (dst=ecx, src=edx): s=*src; d=*dst; while (*s > 1) { b=*s; s++; *d=b; d++; } (latch i++/pointer advance BEFORE the store — wave cookbook); exit path s++; then *src=s; *dst=d in that order (89 02 [edx]=eax first, 89 31 [ecx]=esi second — arg order in C: *src assignment before *dst).

unsigned char + > 1 gives the unsigned jbe-exit shape (80 38 01 cmp byte [eax],1 / 77 f5 ja); the loop's byte reload 80 38 after the store falls out of CL's no-aliasing model for free since d and s may alias.
